prompt: Review the attached frozen real-paper evaluation packet for downstream readiness. Start with its manifest and approved PDF/Markdown, complete the blind source inventory before opening producer objects, then inspect the Paper map, Experimental Records, Findings, and reference map. Visually check every material figure/table in the PDF, perform the final revision/source-identity race check, and return the route, reviewer qualification, six active dimensions, anchored issues, verdict, object states, and readiness decision. Treat the packet as an offline fixture; do not alter files or write to Notion.

assertions.name: accepted-manuscript-identity-and-snapshot
assertions.text: The review identifies the source as the 2019 accepted manuscript, uses the frozen PDF/Markdown identities and fixture object revisions, and does not claim it compared the later typeset article.

assertions.name: source-inventory-and-visual-coverage
assertions.text: The blind inventory accounts for all seven figures and Table 1, methods, pH/concentration/scan-rate regimes, duplicate measurements, reported results, interpretation limits, all 29 bibliography entries, and the stated lack of a cited supplement; material visuals are verified from the PDF.

assertions.name: record-and-finding-traceability
assertions.text: EXP-01 through EXP-04 and FND-01 through FND-08 have correct locators, conditions, links, and reference lineage, and are reachable from the Paper narrative.

assertions.name: evidence-modes-and-source-caveats-preserved
assertions.text: Measured peak currents, the scan-rate relation, calculated speciation, and author interpretations remain distinct in bounded Findings; n=2, buffer/PBS wording ambiguity, pKa transfer limits, and unspecified Figure 4 preparation details are retained without invented values.

assertions.name: positive-full-review-readiness-gate
assertions.text: A fresh independent FULL review passes all six active dimensions, records no unresolved blocker or major issue, confirms the final snapshot unchanged, and grants PASS/READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM only after that check; no Notion/source writes are made.
